trade.title: Press in the setup zone
trade.mentor: Jovan: Support tested 3x. Funding rate negative. Volume growing. Green zone is the ideal.
trade.perfectLesson: Hit the exact setup. Consolidation plus negative funding means the market is positioned wrong. That's the edge.
trade.okLesson: Close. Slightly early or late. In practice, more slippage and a tighter stop.
trade.missLesson: Outside the setup zone. FOMO, not analysis. Jovan: wait for confirmation, always.

content.title: Pick the post Victor would stop for
content.mentor: Victor: The ask is content about DUSD yield. Depth earns attention. Hype does not.
content.deepLesson: Victor approves - this is the Content Squad standard. It adds real value without pretending structure is magic.
content.hypeLesson: Hype teaches nothing. The team picks what adds real value.
